months.note: 5월 중순 무렵 찾아와 5~7월에 알을 낳고, 9월 무렵 남쪽으로 떠난다.

summary: 제주도와 남해안 섬에 사는 새로, 해안이나 섬, 내륙 비탈의 잡목림과 활엽수림에서 지낸다. 땅 위를 걸어 다니며 곤충 따위 먹이를 찾고, 경계심이 강해 가까이 다가가기 어렵다. 바위틈을 둥지로 쓰거나 나무줄기 사이에 타원형 둥지를 짓고, 5~7월에 얼룩무늬가 있는 유백색 알 4~6개를 낳는다. 국외에서는 일본, 중국 동부, 타이완, 보르네오섬 등에 분포한다.

points.en: brown crown with a black central stripe
black band from lores through cheeks and ear coverts to the nape
blue-green back and bright blue lower rump

similar.how: 날개의 파란 무늬와 흰 무늬가 더 크고 머리 옆이 담황색이며, 아랫면의 황갈색이 더 짙다.

art.subject: Fairy Pitta (Pitta nympha), adult as seen in Korean southern island woods from May to September: crown chestnut-brown with a black central stripe; long creamy-buff supercilium reaching the nape; broad black band from the lores through the cheeks and ear-coverts to the nape; throat white; back, scapulars and upper rump deep blue-green; lesser wing coverts shining azure-blue; flight feathers black with a white patch at the base of the primaries; lower rump bright blue; uppertail coverts black tipped blue; neck and breast sides green; breast and flanks buff; lower belly and vent scarlet-red. Bill black; dark eye; legs pale pinkish.
art.pose: walking on the forest floor, searching the leaf litter for insects
art.scene: shady scrub and broadleaf woodland on a slope of a southern Korean island such as Jeju in early summer; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view on the ground: brown crown with a black central stripe, buff supercilium, black face band, white throat, blue-green back, azure shoulder, buff breast and flanks, red lower belly, long pinkish legs
adult, back view on the ground: blue-green back, bright blue lower rump, black uppertail coverts tipped blue, short tail projecting beyond the wingtips
art.build: Small, compact, upright ground bird, sleek rather than ball-shaped, about 18cm, about the length of a Common Starling but much rounder, with a big head, a stout black bill a little shorter than the head, a short tail that still projects clearly beyond the folded wingtips and long pinkish legs. Walks and hops over the leaf litter. Wings short and rounded; in flight a white patch shows at the base of the primaries.
avoid: Do not paint a long tail; it is short, but still projects clearly beyond the folded wings.
Do not paint the whole underparts red; the breast and flanks are buff and only the lower belly and vent are red.
Do not paint a black crown; the crown is brown with a black central stripe and a buff supercilium.
Do not make it large or ball-shaped; it is a compact, sleek, starling-sized ground bird.
